annotation.template:
Get "All rooms" finished - ERROR - Not all rooms were discovered succesfully, error: {{ timer_error }}


Note, Jabber will wait for all rooms discovery (=getting properties of each room) before it displays the list of all discovered rooms. CSCvk79467 implements a timeout if there is no response for some of the rooms discovery. Jabber waits for 6 min if more than 500 rooms or for 3 minutes if less than 500 rooms are configured on the system - the timeout is not configurable. After the timeout, Jabber shows the rooms in the All room view with an information that not all rooms could have been discovered.

pattern.description:
UPN enabled and retrieved: {{ UpnRetrieved }}



What is UPN?

-applicable for clients running on Windows OS connected to a domain

-User Principal Name (UPN) is the name of a system user in an e-mail address format

-client can auto-discover the UPN (e.g. user@cisco.com) and use the domain part for Service Discovery process = DNS SRV lookups (e.g. _cisco-uds.cisco.com)


Advantage:

-Domain is taken from UPN user and user is not prompted for email address.


Drawback:

-This bound to this specific domain only, user is not be able to login with different domain.


How to disable:

-MSI transform: UPN_DISCOVERY_ENABLED=false

If CUCM is enabled for refresh tokens and 401 is received from CUC, then CUCM token will be automatically invalidated. This is as per design.

annotation.template:
UPN enabled and retrieved: {{ UpnRetrieved }}



What is UPN?

-applicable for clients running on Windows OS connected to a domain

-User Principal Name (UPN) is the name of a system user in an e-mail address format

-client can auto-discover the UPN (e.g. user@cisco.com) and use the domain part for Service Discovery process = DNS SRV lookups (e.g. _cisco-uds.cisco.com)


Advantage:

-Domain is taken from UPN user and user is not prompted for email address.


Drawback:

-This bound to this specific domain only, user is not be able to login with different domain.


How to disable:

-MSI transform: UPN_DISCOVERY_ENABLED=false
